events.argText: ◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. Something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE ANACONDA EMPRESS! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
COMBAT! THE ANACONDA EMPRESS! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!
🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
📺 SYSTEM: "THREAT ASSESSMENT: that thing out-rates a solo contestant by a LOT! The audience wants a TEAM! Name your party! Give us something to chant! (No pressure. Some pressure.)"
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")

Kyle squares up to watch. "Give it hell."
COMBAT! MURKCAP! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!
It comes apart — no one in reach, no one chasing. The fight ends; they melt back into the wilds.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
It RAN! Style score: 0. The gamblers wanted blood, but they'll settle for drama.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (You lived to tell it — twice — and now you see the pattern.)
